verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official CLI built for use from terminals, coding agents, scripts and CI/CD. `posthog-cli api` exposes the API and the MCP tool catalog, including SQL queries. It also handles source-map upload, schema management and task CRUD, supports headless env-var auth for agents, and installs via `npx @posthog/wizard cli add`, which adds instructions to your coding agent. The separate agentic wizard CLI also sets up, audits and migrates PostHog in your codebase. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as documented.
